htmlview rich demo

A generic page, not SonarLint content: its own stylesheet, CSS variables, inline styles and interactivity.

Typography

Text with strong, em, bold, italic, underline, strike, deleted and inserted text, marked, small print, HTML, Ctrl+Shift+P, inline code, H2O, E = mc2, and a short inline quotation. Inline styles: red, bold green, translucent highlight, struck grey. Entities & symbols: «quotes» … → ← ↑ ↓ × ÷ ± ≤ ≥ ≠ ∞ ° € £ © ® ™ §. Wide characters: 中文字符, 日本語, 한국어, emoji 🎉🚀🔥👍, and a URL-like long word https://example.com/a/very/long/path/that/does/not/break/naturally/at/all.

Right-aligned paragraph.

This line is white-space: nowrap and will not wrap even when the window is narrow, it just keeps going and going.

pre-wrap keeps multiple spaces and line breaks and indentation, but still wraps long lines when they exceed the available width of the window.

Callouts use a left border, padding and a generated prefix from ::before.

interface User { id: number; name: string }
export async function load(id: number): Promise<User> {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/users/${id}`); // template literal
    return (await res.json()) as User;
}
fn main() {
    let words: Vec<&str> = "hello world".split(' ').collect();
    println!("{} words", words.len());
}
package main
import "fmt"
func main() { fmt.Println("hi", 42) }
SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.id) AS orders
FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.active = TRUE GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY orders DESC;
